narrative: A 24-year-old left Syria in 2012 as life grew increasingly unsafe. He went to Jordan, where he studied filmmaking, and then to Turkey, where he trained as a sound engineer. He made the trek from Izmir to Berlin on foot with a group of friends; the journey took them 23 days. They walked through Macedonia, Serbia and Hungary. In Hungary he was caught by police when he emerged from the forest, and he was beaten and injured in the camps. When he asked for a lawyer, he was told, 'Do you think you're in Sweden?' He arrived in Berlin in August. His parents had settled in Saudi Arabia; his sister was still in Damascus.
